### Stack & Responsibilities
- Backend Go Engineer building k0rdent AI control-plane services for Mirantis, a Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company. Designing APIs, orchestration, authorization, and production-ready cloud-native services.
Backend Go Engineer building Mirantis’s Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure services
- Tech stack: Docker, Kubernetes, Microservices, Python, TypeScript, Go

- Build Go microservices for the multi-tenant k0rdent AI platform
- Model database schemas and write migrations
- Design public REST APIs with OpenAPI and multi-language SDKs
- Implement durable Temporal orchestration with idempotency, retries, timeouts, and determinism constraints
- Build event-driven asynchronous communication using distributed streaming or message-broker platforms
- Implement authentication and authorization using OIDC/JWT, service-to-service authentication, tenant-scoped RBAC, gateway routing, and rate limiting
- Contribute to SCIM-based user and group lifecycle provisioning
- Unify platform API permissions with Kubernetes-native RBAC
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated ability
- Solid computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, concurrency, networking, HTTP, and databases
- 4–5 years of professional software engineering experience
- 2–3+ years building production backend services in Go; 4+ years of Go preferred
- Strong Go fundamentals, including concurrency, context propagation, error wrapping, and standard-library HTTP routing (Go 1.22+)
- Experience building and shipping REST APIs, including versioning and backward compatibility
- Relational database skills: schema design, migrations, transactions, and query tuning
- Unit and integration testing discipline, code review, and CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions or equivalent)

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Backend Go Engineer building k0rdent AI control-plane services for Mirantis, a Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company. Designing APIs, orchestration, authorization, and production-ready cloud-native services.
Backend Go Engineer building Mirantis’s Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure services
Role description:
• Build Go microservices for the multi-tenant k0rdent AI platform
• Model database schemas and write migrations
• Design public REST APIs with OpenAPI and multi-language SDKs
• Implement durable Temporal orchestration with idempotency, retries, timeouts, and determinism constraints
• Build event-driven asynchronous communication using distributed streaming or message-broker platforms
• Implement authentication and authorization using OIDC/JWT, service-to-service authentication, tenant-scoped RBAC, gateway routing, and rate limiting
• Contribute to SCIM-based user and group lifecycle provisioning
• Unify platform API permissions with Kubernetes-native RBAC
• Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for each change
• Instrument production services with structured logging, metrics, and audit trails
• Package and ship services with Docker, Helm, and Kubernetes
• Review peers' code and debug incidents to root cause with regression coverage
• Collaborate with engineering teams across the US, Europe, and India within an agile framework
• Own features end to end, including API contracts, services, schemas, orchestration, tests, and packaging
Role requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated ability
• Solid computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, concurrency, networking, HTTP, and databases
• 4–5 years of professional software engineering experience
• 2–3+ years building production backend services in Go; 4+ years of Go preferred
• Strong Go fundamentals, including concurrency, context propagation, error wrapping, and standard-library HTTP routing (Go 1.22+)
• Experience building and shipping REST APIs, including versioning and backward compatibility
• Relational database skills: schema design, migrations, transactions, and query tuning
• Unit and integration testing discipline, code review, and CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions or equivalent)
• Clear written English for design documents, review comments, and asynchronous collaboration
• Authorization to work in the United States
• Ability to independently research, experiment, and read source code
• A built project that the candidate can explain in detail
• Willingness to receive rigorous code review and feedback
• Ability to explain how code quality and correctness are verified
• Prior experience with multi-tenant SaaS or PaaS platforms, k0s, GPU infrastructure, AI/ML workload scheduling, SCIM, Kubernetes RBAC, sqlc, OpenAPI code generation, observability tools, Python or TypeScript, security engineering, or CNCF contributions is nice to have, not mandatory
Benefits:
• Professional development and training
• Conference and working group attendance
• Company outings, happy hours, hackathons, and tech talks
• Competitive compensation package with a strong benefits plan
• Opportunity to work with passionate colleagues and Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers
• Open-source innovation environment
• High-energy environment valuing openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth
Tech stack:
Docker, Kubernetes, Microservices, Python, TypeScript, Go
